evidence.quote: Non-EU students requiring a visa need to submit the pre-enrolment visa application for the a.y. 2026-2027 on the Universitaly platform within July 15th, 2026.

notes: Tuition left out: the pages state the fee system for students residing abroad only as a table of PIL pro-capite PPA bands (contributo onnicomprensivo unico plus regional tax and stamp duty); no single quote states one lowest and one highest fee for this student, and no quote ties Morocco to a country group for the 2026/27 or 2027/28 academic year, so no figure could be given. Teaching language for this programme is English ("Language English"), while the Italian B2 requirement published on the international application page applies only to programmes taught in Italian. Admission to Business & Management and Economics and Finance with Data Science runs on the SAT with two admission procedures (rounds) in the same year; the first round's pre-enrolment at UniTo is 1 June - 19 June 2026 and the second 1 July - 14 September 2026, while non-EU visa applicants must also pre-enrol on Universitaly by 15 July 2026 (page states a.y. 2026-2027). Equivalents: "Language English" is the only quote for the teaching language; duration taken from the same page's "Duration 3 years".

note.en: The SAT test (code 9136 - University of Turin) is mandatory for this restricted-access programme; register on the College Board portal and send the official score before the admission procedure deadlines.

evidence.quote: When you take the test, you must indicate the code 9136 - University of Turin for the digital submission of the Official SAT Score Report.
